notes: The Optimist (Barnaby, Op 2 Disabled Vessel): generic 7.0 m overall GRP inshore fishing / leisure boat (6.30 m hull, 2.40 m over strakes, draught 0.62 m, roof 2.76 m), walk-in wheelhouse amidships, open aft cockpit, tiller outboard. Replaces the RescueService.buildDisabledBoat greybox (Hull 6x2.4x14 studs, i.e. 4.7 m: the asset is 7.3 x 21.2 studs per docs/12 '7 m'; re-place DECK_SEATS from ATT_Seat_*). MAPPING: Hull/Stripe -> Hull MeshPart (+ Cabin walls, both T_Optimist_Hull; boot-top blue as the greybox stripe); Cabin/Windshield -> Cabin + glass in Fittings; Smoke ball -> ATT_Smoke (outboard cowl); BowPoint attachment -> ATT_BowPoint (stem-head roller, Kit.bowAttachment finds 'BowPoint' by name: rename or alias); people -> ATT_Seat_01/02 (foredeck, skipper waves from 01), ATT_Seat_03/04 (cockpit), ATT_Seat_Helm; keep Torso parts for POB. Tow strong points (Procedures.ATTACH): ATT_Tow_SamsonPost (MeshPart SamsonPost: hide when scenario bow = 'cleats'), ATT_Cleat_Bow_Port/Stbd + ATT_Bridle (bridle apex at the fairlead), ATT_BowRail (weak); stern: ATT_Cleat_Stern_Port/Stbd, spring cleats ATT_Cleat_Spring_*; hazard: MeshPart TrailingRope (stern cleat over the transom, wrapped round the prop; hide when trailingRope = false) + ATT_TrailingRope, ATT_Prop; alongside: ATT_Fender_Port/Stbd (2 fenders stowed on the sole); boarding: ATT_Boarding_Port/Stbd (cockpit gunwale, lowest freeboard), ATT_Door; also ATT_Waterline, ATT_Stern, ATT_NavLight. Port = Roblox -X. Weathering: faded yellowed chalky gelcoat, crazing, repairs, chips, fender / quay scuffs, rust weeps, scum line + slime + weed + sparse barnacles at the waterline, faded navy antifouling; corroded outboard leg (zinc bloom, bare alloy, rust from the clamp), chalky cowl; scuffed navy fenders; weathered teak post; name boards THE OPTIMIST, PLN HV 27. LOD0 8,038 tris in 7 MeshParts (max Fittings 4,116), LOD1 2,749, LOD2 670 (row 25k/10k/2.5k; TrailingRope dropped at LOD2). 3 sets x 1024 + _Wet (Hull, Deck, Fittings; Fittings signal mask). _COL 3 boxes.
